heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: MRGAP pilot in a 10 ft container; 7 reverse-vortex GAP nodes on one anode plate; post-plasma chamber 170 mm x 470 mm, water-jacketed; carbon bed 136 mm x 27 mm at 35 or 65 mm from anode plate; silo with screw feeder; recirculation loop with pump
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The pre-plasma chamber is connected to the CO2 gas input and contains the anode plate, with seven parallel GA reactor nodes ... the post-plasma chamber (diameter = 170 mm, height = 470 mm)

heading: Electricity supply
reported_value: switching-type HV generators, negative output, ~1 kW DC per node
evidence_excerpt_or_description: The PSUs are switching-type high voltage generators with a negative output which drive arc plasmas with a power around 1 kW DC

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: CO2 99.7%, 50-110 L/min total; 50 g activated carbon NORIT PK 3-5 mm; reactor tilted 25 deg; recycle rate 50%
evidence_excerpt_or_description: CO2 (99.7%, Air Liquide) is introduced into the pre-plasma chamber through a singular inlet at a total flow rate of 50 - 110 L min-1 ... 50 g of activated carbon (NORIT PK, 3-5 mm) was initially loaded in the bed
notes: recirculation run used a different carbon (p. 22)
